mapper.select: SELECT bs.booth_slot_id AS boothSlotsId, bs.slot_number AS slotNumber, bs.pos_x AS posX, bs.pos_y AS posY, bs.width AS width, bs.height AS height, bs.price AS price, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_slot aps JOIN application a ON a.application_id = aps.application_id WHERE aps.booth_slot_id = bs.booth_slot_id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ) AS locked FROM booth_slots bs JOIN halls h ON bs.hall_id = h.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = #{fairId} AND bs.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY bs.slot_number
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fairs WHERE fair_id = #{fairId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application (business_id, fair_id, reject_reason, final_price, reviewed_at, payment_due_at) VALUES (#{businessId}, #{fairId}, #{rejectReason}, #{finalPrice}, #{reviewedAt}, #{paymentDueAt})

INSERT INTO application_form (application_id, purpose, items_desc, manager_name, manager_phone, manager_email, agreed_terms, attachment_url) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{purpose}, #{itemsDesc}, #{managerName}, #{managerPhone}, #{managerEmail}, #{agreedTerms}, #{attachmentUrl})
INSERT INTO application_slot (application_id, booth_slot_id, price_at_selection) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{boothSlotId}, #{priceAtSelection})
mapper.select: SELECT application_id, business_id, fair_id, status, reject_reason, final_price, submitted_at, reviewed_at, payment_due_at FROM application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT a.application_id AS applicationId, a.fair_id AS fairId, a.business_id AS businessId, a.status AS status, af.purpose AS purpose, af.items_desc AS itemsDesc, af.manager_name AS managerName, af.manager_phone AS managerPhone, af.manager_email AS managerEmail, a.final_price AS finalPrice, a.reject_reason AS rejectReason, af.attachment_url AS attachmentUrl, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, a.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, acr.status AS cancelRequestStatus, acr.reason AS cancelReason, acr.decided_at AS cancelDecidedAt FROM application a JOIN application_form af ON af.application_id = a.application_id LEFT JOIN application_cancel_request acr ON acr.application_id = a.application_id AND acr.cancel_request_id = ( SELECT MAX(cancel_request_id) FROM application_cancel_request WHERE application_id = a.application_id ) WHERE a.application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT aps.booth_slot_id AS boothSlotsId, bs.slot_number AS slotNumber, aps.price_at_selection AS priceAtSelection FROM application_slot aps JOIN booth_slots bs ON bs.booth_slot_id = aps.booth_slot_id WHERE aps.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY bs.slot_number
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING', final_price = #{finalPrice}, payment_due_at = #{paymentDueAt}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_cancel_request WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED' )
SELECT operation_start_date FROM fairs WHERE fair_id = #{fairId}

SELECT cancel_request_id AS cancelRequestId, application_id AS applicationId, reason, status, requested_at AS requestedAt, decided_at AS decidedAt FROM application_cancel_request WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id FROM payment WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE'
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING'
